scope: frontend isolation under one VINS-Fusion-origin backend
repeat_unit: VINS replay of one arm-window feature bag; identical feature-bag hash across the three repeats

runability.failed_window_accuracy_policy: exclude the entire window from accuracy if any arm or repeat fails

accuracy.alignment: independent fixed-scale proper SE(3) per trajectory
accuracy.common_support: one intersection over all 3 arms x 3 repeats within each window
accuracy.scientific_unit: window; repeats characterize replay variation and are not independent samples

source_lineage_disclosure.policy: do not relabel a KLT fallback or July Learned+KLT trajectory as current XFeat; execute all arms freshly through the same presently pinned exporter and disclose the source-lineage deviation
source_lineage_disclosure.effect_on_attribution: same-exporter, same-backend frontend-method isolation remains valid; byte-exact reproduction of the earlier P execution tree is not claimed

proxy_reference_disclosure: APE/RPE measure agreement with COLMAP or dataset baseline proxy, not independent ground-truth absolute error
optional_loftr: not included in the primary preregistered three-arm table; may only appear in a separately labeled supplemental run
